title: Worker heartbeat file with atomic refresh and age boundary
source: Authored for the CodeReview benchmark corpus (generation-v3 clean-authored stratum), 2026-11-05
false_flag_note: A reviewer might read the alive-at-exactly-TTL result as an off-by-one. The boundary rule is stated in the contract — stale only when age is strictly greater than the TTL — and the check asserts alive at exactly the TTL and stale immediately after it.
